sources.excerpt: BDD tests should describe **observable behaviour**, not implementation details.
sources.scope: Observable outcomes and explicit red-first BDD, not a default Iterate replacement.

sources.excerpt: Do not spend review time on issues that automated tools should catch
sources.scope: Consequence-grounded review and preferred complete remedies; cleanroom is profile-specific.

sources.excerpt: Keep long prompts focused on generation behavior, JSON hints on the exact wire shape/examples, and TL;DRs on compact validated replay.
sources.scope: Targeted coordinated surfaces and application-owned contracts, not new model execution.

sources.excerpt: A broad UC reference is not a completion claim.
sources.scope: Primary/enabling/validation coverage and metadata-aware read-only reconciliation.

sources.excerpt: Do not commit caches, local state, or build artifacts.
sources.scope: Canonical project validation and protected contracts; template commands/routing are not universal.

sources.excerpt: The smoke check is the deployed job run, not only `bundle validate`.
sources.scope: Reporting boundary only, not authority to run jobs or deploy.

sources.excerpt: It does not run notebook code, source queries, or model calls.
sources.scope: Existing saved-evidence pipeline, whitelisted aggregates and honest unavailable checks.

sources.excerpt: Schema/Pydantic domains and actual derivation code take precedence over catalog vocabularies or shortened descriptions.
sources.scope: Definitions and uncertainty cannot be changed by editorial shorthand.
Consequences, S0–S3 and bounded coverage; the separate Python guide is unavailable.

existing_attribution: NOTICE records bdenglish/skills adaptation; canonical Iterate/helper and Debate remain in this repository.
limits: Only the identified method excerpts/context were inspected; full historical reproducibility is not established.
Private engines, restricted clinical artifacts, historical evaluations and the separate smell guide are not distributed.
